title: Nickel-62 from first principles: a zero-parameter nuclear binding maximum in Smithian Fold Theory
description:
Read the full paper (PDF)

Maria Smith derives the unique nickel-62 nuclear binding maximum at 28 protons and 34 neutrons from the SFT zero-parameter ledger. This revised paper presents the generated surface, residual and electromagnetic coefficients, the typed fine-structure return argument, all 25,303 finite candidates, exact rational separation and the unbounded mass-tail argument. It identifies the native Lean certificate and 12,545 audited declarations with zero axiom dependencies.

The complete 2,548-row AME2020 comparison identifies the same maximum, with a 2.2897 keV per nucleon separation between the nickel-62 lower reported uncertainty endpoint and every rival upper endpoint. The original protocol records known development targets and target-inaccessible prediction execution, sealed before table release.

Scientific author: Maria Smith, Ernos Labs. Contact: Maria.smith.sftoe@gmail.com. Community and Discord invitation: https://discord.gg/QCNkzq6kZC.

Revised edition with the complete typed electromagnetic argument. The full paper PDF is the default preview.
